messages:
ara: Quick preflight — panelist onboarding + access keys for Tuesday’s webinar. Need final decisions on: Zoom cloud retention, local backup owners, panelist SSO links, and how we deliver the recording to HubSpot assets. cc @joel @maria

joel: I can own local recording backup. Will ask panelists to record locally as backup + enable host cloud recording.

maria: For retention — legal asked for 90 days for public recordings, but enterprise leads (if any) should be kept 1 year. Can we set cloud retention per-meeting policy?

ara: Yes — Zoom supports meeting-level retention via account setting. Plan: set cloud retention 365 for meetings flagged enterprise, 90 for public. We’ll mark the prod meeting with tag `enterprise=false` by default.

samir: On panelist access — do we send SSO links or generate unique join links with registration required? Which is simpler for non-Redwood partners?

maria: Registration-required unique join links. Less friction than SSO for external speakers. We’ll add a short onboarding doc with pre-join checklist.

kate-marketing: Copy suggestion for onboarding email: "Hi — thanks for joining as a panelist. Please test your mic/camera 24h before, enable local recording (optional), and we’ll provide a single-click join link." cc: CTA to upload headshot.

ara: Perfect. Also need to lock down who gets the cloud recording link (sensitive). Proposed ACL: host + videoops + marketing only, then we export to S3 and push a replay URL to HubSpot. Thoughts?

join: videoops-bot: Recording scheduled. Reminder: enable "Record active speaker, gallery view" and "Record shared screen separately".

videoops-bot: Also creating an RTMP fallback stream key for live stream to CDN. Key expiring 24h after event.

joel: ACL sounds good. I’ll script an export job: Zoom -> S3 (private bucket) -> generate signed URL -> HubSpot file store. Will add a mover Lambda.

maria: For captions/transcript — enable Zoom auto-transcription. We should also run post-process through our transcript cleaner to fix model names and product terms (so evaluations find the right tokens).

ara: Good catch. Postflow checklist draft: 1) Export cloud recording, 2) Run transcript cleaner, 3) Clip highlights (0:00-5:30, panelist q&a), 4) Upload clips to HubSpot, tag by ICP, 5) Trigger nurture sequence.

kate-marketing: Nurture email steps: Day 0 immediate replay link, Day 2 clip + CTA, Day 7 benchmark piece + request for demo. Tag routing: MQL -> SDR queue, Enterprise intent -> AE.

samir: How do we mark enterprise intent from registration? Add a dropdown on reg page: company size / role?

maria: Yes — add fields: company size (0-50,51-200,201-1000,1000+), role (Engineer/Platform/Exec/Other). Map 1000+ or Exec => enterprise flag. Keep required fields minimal to avoid dropoff.

ara: UX note: Reg page should autofill email domain and hint if company looks enterprise. But keep GDPR consent checkbox mandatory (EU folks).

joel: Ops checklist (short commands):
```
# on recording ready
aws s3 cp /tmp/zoom_recording.mp4 s3://redwood-webinars/2026-03-XX/ --acl private
# generate signed url
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-webinars/2026-03-XX/zoom_recording.mp4 --expires-in 604800
```

videoops-bot: Reminder: local backups from panelists should be uploaded to shared folder within 24h. I’ll post a Slack DM to each panelist 15m after event with upload link.

maria: Post-event tagging: add marketing:replay, webinar:topic, lead:reg_source. Makes automations simpler.

kate-marketing: Who owns first-pass clipping? I can do the 3 hero clips if someone provides timestamps, otherwise videoops take full.

joel: I’ll attach a minimal log of recording segments in the export metadata so you have timestamps. Format: JSON lines with start/end and label.

ara: One last: password vs passcode? Zoom now uses passcode. We’ll enable passcode and add to reg confirmation email. Also enable waiting room for attendees, but disable for panelists by whitelisting their emails.

samir: Anything for analytics? We should add UTM params to replay URLs and capture click-throughs in HubSpot.

maria: Done. UTM tags template: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=mar_launch26&utm_medium=email&utm_content={clip_id}

ara: Great. Action items: @joel export job + S3 presign (owner), @kate-marketing prepare onboarding copy + 3 clips (owner), @videoops-bot confirm RTMP key + recording settings, @maria update reg page with enterprise fields and GDPR checkbox. I’ll DM panelists with pre-join checklist.

kate-marketing: ACK. I’ll drop draft onboarding email in #marketing-drafts in 2 hours.

joel: Will have the export Lambda and sample presign URL ready by EOD.

maria: Reg page change pushed to staging. QA link: https://staging.redwood.com/webinar-preflight (please test from incognito + EU IP).

ara: Thanks all — feel free to ping here if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
